messages:
Maya P: Quick sync — final acceptance checklist for go-to-prod. We still have a handful of open items: SLA doc + signoff, support runbook & oncall rota, monitoring alert mapping, pricing page + cost calculator, capacity/burst plan, and legal wording for Dedicated contracts. Who can own what?

Sanika R: I can own the support runbook and playbooks. Need confirmation on oncall headcount and escalation path.

Dmitri L: Monitoring side — I'll cover alert rules and dashboards. Proposed alerts: 95p latency, error-rate >0.5% (5m), KV cache miss spike, and token-spend anomaly. I'll open a PR to add rules to ops-alerts.

Kevin H: I'll take SLA doc and pricing page. For pricing I need final unit definitions (tokens vs embedding units) and burst pricing for Dedicated. Pinging finance for numbers. Docs PR is up: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/987 — needs one more review.

Maya P: Thanks. Minimal gate to green: (a) SLA doc in PR with explicit SLOs and credits model, (b) support runbook + confirmed rota, (c) monitoring alerts live in staging and smoke tests pass, (d) pricing page live in staging with calculator, (e) capacity plan with burst rules and fallback policy, (f) legal signoff queued. If any of these are missing we hold rollout. Deadline: EOD Fri for owners to flag blockers.

Sanika R: For rota: proposing 2x primary + 1x backup for first 72h. Will validate people availability and post rota by tomorrow AM. Also adding a short playbook: "Initial incident -> failover to Dedicated fallback -> notify SLA owners".

Dmitri L: Opening alert PR now: https://git.internal/ops/alerts/merge/452. Test plan: run two synthetic requests sets (50 concurrent, normal vs spike) and assert alert firing. Can pair with Sanika for runbook mapping.

Kevin H: Finance responded: baseline pricing proposal attached in the ticket. We need to agree on burst multipliers and whether to offer a reserved capacity discount. Also legal asked for the escalation policy text for Dedicated — @Maya can you share the stub?

Maya P: Stub sent to legal yesterday; I'll re-share in #legal. Quick decision: freeze model config changes for the rollout window (no model upgrades or quantization switches) until post-72h. We should also enable automatic fallback to smaller-capacity model variant on elevated latency.

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled staging canary window at 2275020000 — ensure teams ready.

Sanika R: Rota confirmed: listed in the runbook PR. Primary: Sanika, Dmitri. Backup: Alex (oncall). Post the rota link in this thread once PR is merged.

Dmitri L: Alert PR merged to staging. Ran smoke tests — latency alert fired as expected on the injected spike. Will promote to prod once runbook + rota exist.

Kevin H: SLA doc updated, includes SLO table and credit calculation. Pricing page staging live at /pricing/staging. Need a quick review from product for customer-facing wording.

Maya P: Good progress. Final gating checklist for go/no-go: 1) SLA PR merged & legal ack, 2) Runbook PR merged + rota confirmed, 3) Monitoring alerts validated in staging, 4) Pricing page + calculator in staging, 5) Capacity/burst playbook in infra, 6) Freeze on model changes. If all green by EOD Fri we plan canary rollout next Tue. If any owner misses deadline, escalate to release council.

Kevin H: I'll follow up with legal and product copy.

Sanika R: I'll finalize runbook and post rota link here.

Dmitri L: I'll schedule the alert promotion and pair on the canary run.

Maya P: Thanks team — please post any blockers here. If nothing critical, we'll treat this as final acceptance criteria and move to canary schedule. :thumbsup:
